BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the RS-2 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 26-H in the area bounded by

A line from a point 200 feet north of West Chelsea Place and perpendicular thereto;
as measured along the public alley next west of South Vincennes Avenue;
South Vincennes Avenue;

and West Chelsea Place.

to those of a RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 11008-11034 South Vincennes Avenue
